_method.categories_from: Kwon et al. whitepaper §6.2 threat list
_method.pairing: adjacent ranks (1,2),(3,4),(5,6) — candidate is the odd rank, control the next-ranked entity of the same type, so the pair is matched on salience rather than the control being less famous
_method.why: hand-picking the entity slot makes a positive result unfalsifiable
